verdict.rationale: cfo.ai's docs say a founder can send investors or the board a read-only link to a report, which covers board sharing with one restricted access level. The evidence does not show team sharing or role-based permissions, granular scoping beyond read-only, or dashboard sharing, and nothing independent corroborates the claim. Missing for 10: team member invites and role-based permissions, scoping options beyond read-only links (e.g. per-page or per-section access, link expiry or revocation), dashboard sharing, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can share dashboards and reports with the board or team under scoped access

citations.quote: Send investors or your board a read-only link to a report.
